ValidationRule.description: Blocks the transition into Closed Won (new record or StageName change) unless a quote is synced (SyncedQuoteId populated). Scoped to the transition so it does not fire on later edits of a Closed Won opp, e.g. deleting its synced quote via a reset utility.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISBLANK(SyncedQuoteId), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sync a quote to this opportunity before marking it Closed Won. Open the quote, use Start Sync, then close the opportunity.
